comment: 6061 aluminium alloy, T6 temper. Density 2.70 g/cm3: Wikipedia '6061 aluminium alloy' (infobox). Hardness 95 HB: typical value of public 6061-T6 datasheets (ASM International / MatWeb), not re-checked here. kc1.1 700 N/mm2: approximate value for force estimates, of the order published for wrought aluminium (ISO 513 group N) in tooling handbooks; not from a specific table. mc 0.25: approximate, the typical value of row 22, aluminium wrought alloy, hardenable, in the material group table 'according to DIN / ISO 513 and VDI 3323' (ISCAR catalogue page 'Material Groups'). Cutting data for this material are in the tools' presets.
name: 6061-T6
